tasks.title: Create go.mod, cmd/ and internal/ placeholders, and .gitignore entries
steps: Write TS-01-1..4 as Go tests in internal/skeleton/skeleton_test.go (test-only package; shell out to git and read files; resolve the repo root relative to the test file) and confirm they fail
Create go.mod with `module github.com/agent-fox-dev/forked-repo` and `go 1.22`, no require block
Create empty cmd/.gitkeep and internal/.gitkeep
Check .gitignore for an existing bin/ rule; add `bin/` and make sure nothing ignores cmd/, internal/, the .gitkeep files, Makefile or docs/generated/ (add negations if the Python template does)
Leave LICENSE untouched and add no other top-level directory

tasks.title: Write the portable Makefile with help, build, test, fmt, vet, check, clean
steps: Write TS-01-5..11 and TS-01-18 as Go tests (use temp copies of the Makefile with generated cmd/app packages) and confirm they fail
Create Makefile with `GO ?= go`, `.PHONY` for all eight targets, and `help` as first target printing each target with a one-line description (grep/sed on `##` comments or plain echo; POSIX only)
build: `$(GO) build ./...` and, when cmd/ has main packages, `$(GO) build -o bin/ ./cmd/...`; must succeed on the empty tree
test, vet run `$(GO) test ./...` and `$(GO) vet ./...`; fmt runs `$(GO) fmt ./...`
check: `$(MAKE) fmt vet build test` style sequential recipe (each step as its own command so failure stops later steps; do not rely on prerequisite ordering with -j)
clean: `rm -rf bin`
Avoid .ONESHELL, $(file, &:, [[ ]], bashisms; every go call uses $(GO)

tasks.title: Implement make doc with per-package go doc -all output
steps: Write TS-01-12..17 and TS-01-19 as Go tests and confirm they fail
Add `doc` recipe: rm stale docs/generated/* files (keep .gitkeep), mkdir -p docs/generated, touch docs/generated/.gitkeep
Enumerate packages via `$(GO) list ./...` (capture output first so failures propagate), filter out paths containing /internal/ or /examples/ or ending in /internal or /examples using case patterns
Name each file by stripping the module prefix, replacing / with _, appending .txt; module root is root.txt
Run `$(GO) doc -all <importpath> > file` and abort with non-zero status on failure
Use only POSIX tools

tasks.title: Write the required documentation files
steps: Write TS-01-20 and TS-01-21 as Go tests (steering says not to test docs, but these are mandated by the test spec; keep them light) and confirm they fail
Create docs/architecture.md describing cmd/, internal/, docs/generated/ and the module path
Create docs/api.md with a one-line no REST/public Go API statement
Create docs/cli.md with a one-line no-CLI statement and the eight make targets
Create docs/configuration.md with a one-line none-yet statement mentioning the Makefile GO variable
Extend README.md keeping the title and description line, adding layout, Go 1.22 and make targets
Run make doc and make check

tasks.title: Verify skeleton paths end to end
steps: Write TS-01-22..24 against a real clone/copy using the real Makefile, Go toolchain and git, and confirm they pass
Trace 01-PATH-1, 01-PATH-2 and 01-PATH-3 through the real Makefile; confirm each target invokes the next step and nothing is stubbed
Confirm the doc and clean targets' contracts are produced by the real Makefile recipes, not only tests
Grep Makefile, go.mod and docs for TODO, TBD and stub markers and remove any
Confirm gofmt -l . is clean and make check passes
